verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a spend-management and accounts-payable platform, so AI-assisted procurement intake is a fair question for it. The evidence pack shows no AI parsing of vendor contracts and no procurement request forms. The Bills API (vendor invoices) and AgentOS (agent toolkit) are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor contracts parsed by AI to auto-populate procurement request forms
